view_type: design concept board with installation rendering
caption: Competition exhibition board for The Waiting Machine, showing a public spatial installation render with light wood mechanical waterwheel-like structure, gray architectural interior, dark lattice ceiling, wood wall panel, human scale cutout figures, bold Chinese title 露骨的期待, English title The Waiting Machine, and a lower design concept text strip in a clean white board layout.
positive_aesthetic_notes: strong opening board that combines project title, spatial render, and concept paragraph
installation is readable as a wood mechanical public device
human figures provide scale without dominating the scene
black title and orange-free restraint keep the board mostly sober
negative_failure_notes: do not overtrain cutout people style as required for all boards
avoid turning the dark lattice ceiling into random dirty visual noise
do not generate dense Chinese concept copy without verified text
text_accuracy_notes: Large title text is readable; lower Chinese paragraph should be treated as layout reference unless source text is supplied.
layout_notes: Large render dominates upper area; title overlays lower-left of render; concept heading and paragraph sit in a lower horizontal information band.

caption: Location analysis exhibition board for The Waiting Machine, large grayscale urban map with grid overlay, highlighted white district boundary, orange site marker and orange rectangular project area, right-side stacked rounded text callout boxes for coordinates, terrain and traffic notes, bilingual heading 设计对象-位置 / Location, and a bottom Chinese explanatory paragraph with orange legend marker.
positive_aesthetic_notes: clear map hierarchy using grayscale base and orange highlight
right-side callout column organizes location facts cleanly
orange accents are sparse and functional
large map area supports environmental art site analysis
negative_failure_notes: do not hallucinate exact coordinates or map labels
avoid making map texture too busy or dirty
do not overuse rounded callout boxes if the board requires a different hierarchy
text_accuracy_notes: Use heading and structural callouts as layout signals; exact map labels, coordinates, and long Chinese paragraphs require source verification.
layout_notes: Map occupies central width; title and section label at top-left; pale project title watermark near top; right callout column; bottom caption and legend.

caption: Design logic board for The Waiting Machine, white competition presentation layout with bilingual heading 设计逻辑 / Design Logic, orange vertical marker bullets, dense Chinese explanatory text blocks, a rounded box for design thinking steps, right-side process diagrams with plus and equals symbols, gray line-art mechanism sketches, and a final black mechanical structure elevation at lower right.
positive_aesthetic_notes: good example of translating design narrative into structured logic blocks
orange markers guide reading without overwhelming the board
right-side diagram chain clearly explains mechanism composition
white space and thin gray lines keep technical content ordered
negative_failure_notes: do not train dense text paragraphs as exact copy
avoid arbitrary plus/equal diagrams without a clear process relation
do not let line-art mechanism sketches become noisy or low-contrast
text_accuracy_notes: Headings and labels are readable; dense Chinese paragraphs and numbered steps should be source-controlled before exact generation.
layout_notes: Left narrative column, center boxed design-thinking list, right process flow and final mechanism drawing, with pale project title watermark across top.

caption: Mechanism illustration board for The Waiting Machine, white presentation page with bilingual heading 说明图 / Illustration, small wood-and-metal transmission shaft diagram at upper left, large semi-transparent gray 3D mechanism rendering on the right, multiple bright orange arrows showing motion direction and rotation, left-side Chinese bullet labels with orange markers, and a bottom explanatory sentence.
positive_aesthetic_notes: excellent reference for mechanism annotation with orange directional arrows
large 3D detail render is clear and technical
left-side marker labels create a simple reading path
white background prevents mechanical detail from feeling too heavy
negative_failure_notes: do not generate arrows randomly; arrows must explain actual motion direction
avoid making mechanical render overly transparent or unreadable
do not reproduce dense Chinese explanation without source text
text_accuracy_notes: Use labels as layout and annotation structure; exact technical Chinese text requires source copy.
layout_notes: Small component detail on upper left, label column below, large annotated mechanism view framed on the right, bottom note line across the page.

caption: Final rendering exhibition board for The Waiting Machine, clean white layout with bold black Chinese title 露骨的期待, bilingual heading 效果图 / Rendering, small full installation render at left, large close-up render of light wood mechanical structure at right, thin orange divider line and solid orange rectangle accent, bottom Chinese interpretation paragraph, restrained architectural presentation style.
positive_aesthetic_notes: strong final-effect board with two render scales and generous white space
orange divider and block accent add identity without clutter
large close-up rendering highlights material and mechanical structure
clear title area creates project recognition
negative_failure_notes: do not add excessive render thumbnails
avoid making white space feel empty by scattering unrelated icons
do not generate long Chinese paragraph without exact source
text_accuracy_notes: Large title and section heading are readable; bottom paragraph should remain placeholder unless source copy is provided.
layout_notes: Title cluster at upper left, small render below title, large render to the right, bottom explanation band with orange accent block.
